needs_human.note: The highlight hook now runs before content has loaded and can scroll the empty <pre> into view (F2).; The capture controller is not published while the file is loading or at the Load prompt, and a new store is published after each load (F3).

The highlight effect now runs on an empty pre on the first render or right after Load, which causes an early scrollIntoView and a dev console warning (F2).; The document-capture controller is null during the prompt, loading and error states, and a new store instance is published each time TextLines mounts (F3).
